description: มุน 2026-07-28 (calendar Phase 2): the ปฏิทินดวง month view (Figma 375:16710) — the grade grid + legend + score card + CTA replace goo's Phase-0 scaffold, bound to goo's useCalendarMonth/dayCellTier (hooks/routing unchanged). The grade/day-cell COLOR SYSTEM is a single source: features/v2-calendar/components/grade-colors.ts holds GRADE_COLORS (10-step) + DAY_CELL_COLORS (3-tier) + markers, every hex copied verbatim from DESIGN.md (NOT eyeballed from Figma) — done-condition 6 (ระบบเกรด 10 ระดับ = component เดียว, ไม่มี hardcode สีกระจาย). Cells read the tint via goo's dayCellTier(percent); the score ring reads GRADE_COLORS by grade; the C+ contrast-exception (#374151) is encoded once. Bug-class the anchor owns (pixels lie about which color): tier-fidelity — every cell's computed bg MUST equal the DESIGN.md tint for its percent (or the selected sapphire), so a hardcoded/wrong tint (invisible to tsc) is caught; selected+marker — the today cell is sapphire-filled, วันพระ cells carry the #9D85DA inset ring; no-overflow-x @393/360/320. done-condition 8 proven with goo's SHARED trackAppFetches (imported, request-level, one code path both lenses): 0 app-fetch → console-0 WITHOUT booting BE (the calendar seam that would have needed BE in zone56 does NOT recur — the mock reaches no /api·:4000·:3100). Teeth mut-hardcode-tier (repaint a cell off-DESIGN) CAUGHT. Rendered @393 matches Figma 375:16710 (grid · tier tints · grade badges · selected day-28 · วันพระ rings · legend · green score-ring B/75% · CTA). SEAM logged (not silently papered): goo's AppShell renders an icon-tab nav with NO Mate AI, but Figma's calendar bottom menu is the CalendarMenu (state Normal, WITH Mate AI) — a nav- integration seam that also intersects ฟีม's pending tab-icon decision; flagged to บอง, not resolved unilaterally. Date selectors are prev/next arrows + month/พ.ศ. display (goo's cursor API) vs Figma's dropdowns — a functional adaptation of the available hook. gate_layer=visual/color-fidelity.
